name: Angry_4
short_caption: The robot raises its left arm with a clenched fist in a brief gesture of frustration or resolve, then returns to neutral.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral stance, the robot swiftly lifts its left arm up and forward, clenching its hand into a tight fist near shoulder height. Its head tilts slightly upward and to the left to track the raised fist. The robot holds this tense posture for a brief moment before lowering the arm and returning its head to the front-facing neutral position.
